lines.speaker: 店員
lines.romaji: irasshaimase. go-chuumon wa nan desu ka.
lines.translation: Welcome. What would you like to order?

lines.speaker: Yui
lines.romaji: koohii o hitotsu kudasai.
lines.translation: One coffee, please.

lines.speaker: 店員
lines.romaji: hotto to aisu, dochira ni shimasu ka.
lines.translation: Hot or iced?

lines.speaker: Yui
lines.romaji: aisu de onegai shimasu.
lines.translation: Iced, please.

lines.speaker: 店員
lines.romaji: tennai de o-meshiagari desu ka.
lines.translation: Will you eat in?

lines.speaker: Yui
lines.romaji: iie, mochikaeri de.
lines.translation: No, takeaway.

lines.speaker: 店員
lines.romaji: kashikomarimashita. sanbyaku en desu.
lines.translation: Certainly. That will be 300 yen.

lines.speaker: Sora
lines.romaji: shuumatsu wa nani o shimasu ka.
lines.translation: What are you doing this weekend?

lines.speaker: Mika
lines.romaji: doyoubi ni eiga o mimasu.
lines.translation: I'm going to see a movie on Saturday.

lines.speaker: Sora
lines.romaji: ii desu ne. donna eiga desu ka.
lines.translation: Nice. What kind of movie?

lines.speaker: Mika
lines.romaji: anime no eiga desu. issho ni ikimasen ka.
lines.translation: An anime movie. Want to come along?

lines.speaker: Sora
lines.romaji: hai, ikitai desu. nanji ni aimashou ka.
lines.translation: Yes, I'd like to. What time shall we meet?

lines.speaker: Mika
lines.romaji: niji ni eki de aimashou.
lines.translation: Let's meet at the station at two.

lines.speaker: 店員
lines.romaji: o-bentou wa atatamemasu ka.
lines.translation: Shall I heat up the bento?

lines.speaker: Taro
lines.romaji: hai, onegai shimasu.
lines.translation: Yes, please.

lines.speaker: 店員
lines.romaji: fukuro wa go-riyou desu ka.
lines.translation: Would you like a bag?

lines.speaker: Taro
lines.romaji: iie, daijoubu desu. kaado de haraemasu ka.
lines.translation: No, I'm fine. Can I pay by card?

lines.speaker: 店員
lines.romaji: hai, kochira ni tatchi shite kudasai.
lines.translation: Yes, please tap it here.

lines.speaker: Taro

tokens.surface: ありがとうございます
tokens.reading: ありがとうございます

lines.romaji: arigatou gozaimasu.
lines.translation: Thank you.

lines.romaji: watashi no ie ni wa chiisai niwa ga arimasu.
lines.translation: My house has a small garden.

lines.romaji: maiasa, shiroi neko ga kimasu.
lines.translation: Every morning, a white cat comes.

lines.romaji: neko wa ki no shita de nemasu.
lines.translation: The cat sleeps under the tree.

lines.romaji: watashi wa mado kara neko o mimasu.
lines.translation: I watch the cat from the window.

lines.romaji: kyou, neko wa tomodachi to issho ni kimashita.
lines.translation: Today, the cat came with a friend.

dialogues.title: I駅の一夜
dialogues.attribution: Adapted from 中谷宇吉郎「Ｉ駅の一夜」(1946), which is in the public domain, via Aozora Bunko / Soranoha (text encoding CC0). Rewritten in simple Japanese for HitaruJP.
dialogues.author: 中谷宇吉郎
dialogues.description: A scientist on his way to Tokyo is stuck in a snowy, blacked-out town during the war. A kind young innkeeper's wife, who loves his books, gives him a room full of books for the night.

lines.romaji: sensou no toki no hanashi desu.
lines.translation: This story is from the time of the war.

lines.romaji: sono koro, yoru wa denki o keshinakereba narimasen deshita.
lines.translation: In those days, we had to turn off the lights at night.

lines.romaji: machi wa itsumo kurakatta desu.
lines.translation: The towns were always dark.

lines.romaji: watashi wa shigoto de, toukyou e iku kisha ni notte imashita.
lines.translation: I was on a train to Tokyo for work.

lines.romaji: morioka ni tsuku to, eki no mawari ga yakete imashita.
lines.translation: When I reached Morioka, the area around the station had burned.

lines.romaji: sono asa, hikouki ga kite, machi o yaita no desu.
lines.translation: That morning, planes had come and burned the town.

lines.romaji: kisha wa morioka made shika ikimasen deshita.
lines.translation: The train would go no farther than Morioka.

lines.romaji: watashi wa tsugi no kisha o sanjikan machimashita.
lines.translation: I waited three hours for the next train.

lines.romaji: demo, hito ga totemo ookute, noremasen deshita.
lines.translation: But there were so many people that I could not get on.

lines.romaji: mata nijikan matte, yatto tsugi no kisha ni norimashita.
lines.translation: I waited two more hours and finally got on the next train.

lines.romaji: demo, sono kisha mo hito de ippai deshita.
lines.translation: But that train was also full of people.

lines.romaji: watashi wa iriguchi no chikaku ni, zutto tatte imashita.
lines.translation: I stood near the door the whole time.

lines.romaji: yoru ni naru to, kaze ga tsumetaku narimashita.
lines.translation: When night came, the wind turned cold.

lines.romaji: ashi mo totemo tsukaremashita.
lines.translation: My legs were very tired, too.

lines.romaji: "kono mama toukyou made tatte iku no wa, muri da."
lines.translation: "I can't stand all the way to Tokyo like this."

lines.romaji: shashou-san ni hanasu to, kou iimashita.
lines.translation: I talked to the conductor, and he said this.

lines.romaji: "I-eki de orite, hitoban tomatte wa dou desu ka. asa, hayai kisha ga arimasu yo."
lines.translation: "Why not get off at I Station and stay the night? There is an early train in the morning."

lines.romaji: "demo, ima kara tomareru yado wa, nai kamo shiremasen."
lines.translation: "But you may not find an inn to stay at now."

lines.romaji: watashi wa gaman dekinaku natte, I-eki de orimashita.
lines.translation: I could not bear it any longer, and I got off at I Station.

lines.romaji: yoru no kuji sugi deshita.
lines.translation: It was past nine at night.

lines.romaji: yuki ga futte ite, machi wa makkura deshita.
lines.translation: It was snowing, and the town was pitch dark.

lines.romaji: eki no mae no kouban de, omawari-san ni kikimashita.
lines.translation: At the police box in front of the station, I asked the policeman.

lines.romaji: "kono chikaku ni, tomareru yado wa arimasen ka."
lines.translation: "Is there an inn near here where I can stay?"

lines.romaji: "imagoro wa, muri deshou ne." omawari-san wa tsumetai koe de iimashita.
lines.translation: "At this hour, probably not," the policeman said coldly.

lines.romaji: shigoto de toukyou e iku tokoro da to hanashite mo, kiite moraemasen deshita.
lines.translation: I told him I was on my way to Tokyo for work, but he would not listen.

lines.romaji: oshiete moratta yado ni nikken ikimashita ga, dochira mo "ippai desu" to iimashita.
lines.translation: I went to the two inns he named, but both said, "We are full."

lines.romaji: kouban ni modoru to, omawari-san wa okotte imashita.
lines.translation: When I went back to the police box, the policeman was angry.

lines.romaji: "nankai kite mo dame desu yo. koko no denwa wa, machi ni wa kakeraremasen."
lines.translation: "It's no use coming back again. The phone here can't call anywhere in town."

lines.romaji: watashi wa akiramete, mata yuki no michi o arukimashita.
lines.translation: I gave up and walked along the snowy road again.

lines.romaji: yuki wa dondon tsuyoku narimashita. soto de neru koto wa dekimasen.
lines.translation: The snow grew heavier and heavier. I could not sleep outside.

lines.romaji: sono toki, ookii yado no mae ni, hirokute hikui furui ie ga miemashita.
lines.translation: Then I saw a wide, low, old house in front of a big inn.

lines.romaji: mukashi no yado no you na ie desu.
lines.translation: It looked like an inn from the old days.

lines.romaji: omoikitte to o akeru to, kagi wa kakatte imasen deshita.
lines.translation: I took a chance and opened the door. It was not locked.

tokens.surface: かっていませんでした

lines.romaji: naka wa hirokute kurakute, oku ni chiisai denki ga hitotsu, tsuite imashita.
lines.translation: It was wide and dark inside, but one small light was on at the back.

lines.romaji: "sumimasen. gohan wa irimasen. hitoban dake tomete kudasai."
lines.translation: "Excuse me. I don't need a meal. Please let me stay just one night."

lines.romaji: onna no hito ga dete kite iimashita. "sumimasen ga, ippai desu. futon mo arimasen."
lines.translation: A woman came out and said, "I'm sorry, but we're full. And we have no futons."

lines.romaji: "futon ga nakute mo ii n desu. kooto ga arimasu. kono yuki no naka de wa, soto de neraremasen."
lines.translation: "I don't need a futon. I have a coat. I can't sleep outside in this snow."

lines.romaji: sono toki, oku kara wakai onna no hito no koe ga shimashita.
lines.translation: Then I heard a young woman's voice from the back.

lines.romaji: "hana-san, futon wa hontou ni ichimai mo nai no?"
lines.translation: "Hana, is there really not a single futon?"

lines.romaji: "natsu no futon ga nimai aru dake desu." to, hana-san wa kotaemashita.
lines.translation: "Only two summer futons," Hana answered.

lines.romaji: "sore de juubun desu." to watashi wa iimashita.
lines.translation: "That's plenty," I said.

lines.romaji: "kawaisou desu kara, tomete agete kudasai. o-kyaku-san, o-namae to juusho o oshiete kudasaimasen ka."
lines.translation: "Poor man. Please let him stay. Sir, would you tell me your name and address?"

lines.romaji: watashi wa meishi o dashite, ayashii mono de wa arimasen to hanashimashita.
lines.translation: I handed over my business card and said I was not a suspicious person.

lines.romaji: hana-san wa meishi o motte, oku ni hairimashita. nakanaka dete kimasen deshita.
lines.translation: Hana took the card to the back. She did not come out for a long time.

lines.romaji: oku kara, gotogoto to oto ga kikoemashita.
lines.translation: I heard thumping sounds from the back.

lines.romaji: shibaraku shite, koe no onna no hito ga dete kimashita.
lines.translation: After a while, the woman with the voice came out.

lines.romaji: "shitsurei shimashita. konogoro wa abunai node, sumimasen deshita. douzo, o-agari kudasai."
lines.translation: "Forgive my rudeness. These days it is dangerous, so I'm sorry. Please come in."

lines.romaji: "kutsu wa watashi ga mochimasu. nikai e douzo."
lines.translation: "I'll take your shoes. Please come up to the second floor."

lines.romaji: sono hito wa kurai kaidan o, saki ni agarimashita. watashi wa ashimoto o sagashinagara, tsuite ikimashita.
lines.translation: She went up the dark stairs ahead of me. I followed, feeling for each step.

lines.romaji: kaidan no tochuu de, sono hito wa iimashita.
lines.translation: Halfway up, she said,

lines.romaji: "sensei ga konya koko ni irassharu nante, yume no you desu. watashi wa sensei no hon ga daisuki de, itsumo yonde iru n desu."
lines.translation: "I never dreamed you would be here tonight, sir. I love your books and always read them."

lines.romaji: "o-kyaku-san no heya wa, mou arimasen. moushiwake arimasen ga, watashi no heya de yasunde moraemasen ka."
lines.translation: "We have no more rooms. I'm very sorry, but could you rest in my room?"

tokens.surface: もうしわけありません

lines.romaji: ichijikan mo kurai michi o aruite, yatto akarui heya ni hairimashita.
lines.translation: After walking an hour in the dark, I finally entered a bright room.

lines.romaji: chiisai heya deshita.
lines.translation: It was a small room.

lines.romaji: sono hito wa aoi fuku o kite imashita. sanjussai gurai no, atama no yosasou na, kirei na hito deshita.
lines.translation: She was wearing a blue outfit. She was about thirty, clever-looking and beautiful.

lines.romaji: watashi mo odorokimashita ga, ichiban odoroita no wa, heya deshita.
lines.translation: I was surprised, too, but what surprised me most was the room.

lines.romaji: futatsu no kabe ga, zenbu hondana de, hon ga gisshiri narande imashita.
lines.translation: Two walls were all bookshelves, packed tight with books.

lines.romaji: nihon no furui hon mo, eigo no hon mo arimashita.
lines.translation: There were old Japanese books and English books.

lines.romaji: tatami no ue ni mo hon ga takusan oite atte, futon o shiku basho ga sukoshi dake arimashita.
lines.translation: Many books were laid out on the tatami too, with only a little space for a futon.

lines.romaji: watashi wa, sakki made yuki no kurai machi o aruite ita koto o, sukkari wasuremashita.
lines.translation: I completely forgot that just a moment ago I had been walking in the dark, snowy town.

lines.romaji: sono hito ga ocha o motte kite kuremashita. watashi wa kikimashita.
lines.translation: She brought me tea. I asked her,

lines.romaji: "daigaku de, nani o benkyou shimashita ka."
lines.translation: "What did you study at university?"

lines.romaji: "eigo no bungaku desu. sotsugyou shite kara, kaisha de sukoshi hatarakimashita."
lines.translation: "English literature. After I graduated, I worked at a company for a while."

lines.romaji: "sono ato kuni ni kaette, gakkou no sensei ni narimashita. otto wa, kokugo no sensei desu."
lines.translation: "Then I went back home and became a school teacher. My husband teaches Japanese."

lines.romaji: "kono yado wa, otto no ryoushin ga mukashi kara yatte imasu. otousan ga nakunatte, yameyou to omoimashita."
lines.translation: "My husband's parents have run this inn for a long time. When his father died, I thought we should close it."

lines.romaji: "demo, kono machi ni wa yado ga sukunai n desu. mainichi, shigoto de toukyou e iku hito ga kimasu. keisatsu mo, yamete wa ikenai to iimasu."
lines.translation: "But there are few inns in this town. Every day, people on their way to Tokyo for work come. The police say we must not close."

lines.romaji: "yado no shigoto wa taihen desu. demo, sukoshi wa kuni no yaku ni tatte iru to omotte, ganbatte imasu."
lines.translation: "The inn's work is hard. But I think it helps the country a little, so I keep trying."

lines.romaji: "ichiban komaru no wa, hon o yomu jikan ga nai koto desu."
lines.translation: "What troubles me most is that I have no time to read."

lines.romaji: watashi wa hanashi o kikinagara, omoimashita.
lines.translation: Listening to her, I thought.

lines.romaji: kono kuni no chikara wa, kou iu hito no, mienai tokoro ni aru no kamo shiremasen.
lines.translation: Perhaps the strength of this country lies quietly in people like her, where no one can see.

lines.romaji: tsukue no ue ni, atarashii hon ga issatsu arimashita.
lines.translation: There was one new book on the desk.

lines.romaji: "atarashii hon desu ne. kono machi de, douyatte katta no desu ka."
lines.translation: "That's a new book. How did you buy it in this town?"

lines.romaji: "chikaku no K-machi ni, mezurashii hon'ya-san ga imasu. maitsuki, toukyou e itte, minna no hon o katte kite kuremasu."
lines.translation: "In nearby K Town there is an unusual bookseller. Every month he goes to Tokyo and buys books for everyone."

lines.romaji: "takusan oshaberi shimashita. ashita no asa wa hayai desu ne. yukkuri yasunde kudasai."
lines.translation: "I have talked a lot. You leave early tomorrow morning. Please rest well."

lines.romaji: "shujin mo sensei ni aitagatte imashita ga, kaze de yasunde imasu." sou itte, sono hito wa shita e ikimashita.
lines.translation: "My husband wanted to meet you, too, but he is resting with a cold." Saying so, she went downstairs.

tokens.surface: 会いたがっていました
tokens.reading: あいたがっていました

lines.romaji: sono ato, hana-san ga kami no tsutsumi o motte kimashita.
lines.translation: After that, Hana brought a paper package.

lines.romaji: "asagohan no kawari ni, to okusan ga iimashita."
lines.translation: "For your breakfast, the lady said."

lines.romaji: akeru to, shiroi omochi ga itsutsu haitte imashita.
lines.translation: I opened it and found five white rice cakes inside.

lines.romaji: tsugi no asa, yoji han ni okimashita.
lines.translation: The next morning I got up at half past four.

lines.romaji: minna ga okinai you ni, shizuka ni yado o demashita.
lines.translation: I left the inn quietly so as not to wake anyone.

lines.romaji: yuki wa mou yande ite, hoshi ga futatsu mittsu miemashita.
lines.translation: The snow had stopped, and two or three stars were visible.

lines.romaji: kisha wa suite ite, o-kyaku-san wa sannin dake deshita.
lines.translation: The train was empty, with only three passengers.

lines.romaji: watashi wa, kinou no yoru no koto wa yume datta no kamo shirenai to omoinagara, shiroku natte iku higashi no sora o mite imashita.
lines.translation: I wondered whether last night had been a dream, and watched the eastern sky grow pale.
